name: Becca Worthington
seoDescription: Becca Worthington is an Indigenous actor, singer, and dancer based in New York City and Oklahoma, and a proud member of the Cherokee Nation.

children.text: Becca Worthington (she/her) is an actress based in New York City and Oklahoma. She is a proud member of the Cherokee Nation with Choctaw ancestry. From Native Voices in Los Angeles to The Kennedy Center in D.C., Becca has worked coast-to-coast in both theatre and film. With her BFA in Musical Theatre from Texas Tech University and a passion for comedy, Becca brings genuine and energetic consideration to her work both on and off the stage.
Becca is represented by NTA Talent in LA, Resolute Artists Agency in NYC/ATL and Reel Talent Studio in Oklahoma.

title: Channeling Our Ancestors
summary: An original piece co-authored and directed by Becca for the Tulsa Performing Arts Center – a love letter to contemporary Native life.

children.text: Becca co-authored and directed an original piece for the Tulsa Performing Arts Center. Channeling Our Ancestors is a love letter to contemporary Native life. The show explores themes of identity, appropriation, the connection of generations, and bringing heritage and traditions forward into modern life. Through a series of comedic sketches based on popular TV show tropes, audiences will be entertained and educated on what it means to be an Indigenous person in today’s society.
